functions.name: ParseAddress
functions.summary: ParseAddress parses a single RFC 5322 address, e.g. "Barry Gibbs <bg@example.com>"

functions.name: ParseAddressList
functions.summary: ParseAddressList parses the given string as a list of addresses.

functions.name: ParseDate
functions.summary: ParseDate parses an RFC 5322 date string.

functions.name: ReadMessage
functions.summary: ReadMessage reads a message from r. The headers are parsed, and the body of the message will be available for reading from msg.Body.
